selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a baseball and not a similar spherical object with fake stitching.
To detect subtle texture anomalies, melting, or inconsistencies in the leather grain and stitch geometry that might indicate AI generation.
To ensure the stitches are physically connected to the leather and do not float or merge incorrectly with the background or surface.
To verify the 3D structure of the ball is consistent and the depth of field effects are realistic.

focus_areas: Edge sharpness between stitches and leather
Lighting and shadow consistency on raised stitches
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the regularity of the stitches. AI often fails to maintain consistent spacing and angle for the double-stitches. Check if the holes for the stitching look punched or just painted on. Verify if the leather grain wraps naturally around the curvature without distortion.
